question: Is the lower near-threshold particle-sampled field strength in AuroraPIC associated with weaker grid electric fields in the same region and phase, differential particle localization within that field, or both?

basis.observed_before_declaration: The prospective mover decomposition supports lower quadratic kick work in both AuroraPIC microstates. The existing phase-resolved grid-field outputs have not been reduced over the critical scope or compared for this question.
basis.post_hoc_status: This rule is prospective with respect to the declared grid-field and sampling-factor reductions, but reuses already generated locked production outputs.

grid_contract.spatial_reduction: piecewise-linear boundary interpolation followed by trapezoidal integration of squared phase-mean grid field, divided by region width
grid_contract.phase_reduction: arithmetic mean over phase bins 50 through 74

derived_metrics.grid_mean_squared_field_V2_m2: critical phase/space mean of squared phase-mean grid electric field
derived_metrics.grid_rms_field_V_m: square root of grid mean squared field
derived_metrics.particle_sampling_factor: particle-sampled mean squared field divided by grid mean squared field

prospective_decision_rule.grid_field_deficit_supported_if: both AuroraPIC/native grid-mean-squared-field ratios are at most 0.90
prospective_decision_rule.differential_particle_sampling_deficit_s: both AuroraPIC/native particle-sampling-factor ratios are at most 0.90
prospective_decision_rule.aurorapic_repeatability_gate: relative two-member range no greater than 0.10 for grid mean squared field and particle sampling factor
prospective_decision_rule.native_repeatability_gate: relative three-seed range no greater than 0.15 for grid mean squared field and particle sampling factor
prospective_decision_rule.multiple_supported_mechanisms: allowed; grid amplitude and conditional particle localization can differ simultaneously

claim_boundary: This prospective reduction distinguishes grid-field amplitude from conditional particle sampling in one previously localized region/phase window of one matched argon CCP. It does not identify the first temporal divergence, compare experiment, establish a published benchmark pass, or prove general PIC correctness.
